Start from each `record` record; combine it with each `event` record for which ID (`event.ID`) equals Event ID (`record.Event_ID`), one combined record per match (a record without a match is dropped); group the kept records by event name (`event.Name`); each group gives one result row; for each result row, return (1) event name (`event.Name`); (2) the number of records in the group.
Step 2. Start from the rows of step 1; all kept records form one group, which gives one result row; for each result row, return (1) the sum of column (2) of step 1 in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none).

Here A is column (3) of step 3; B is column (1) of step 4.
Step 6 (the answer).
